'''Verona''' (Japanese: '''コノハ''' ''Konoha'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP134|Promoting Healthy Tangrowth!]]''. She is a {{tc|Pokémon Ranger}} who watches over a forest near [[Lake Acuity]].

Verona first approached {{Ash}} and {{an|Brock}}, warning them not to enter the forest because of a {{p|Tangrowth}} that uses {{m|Absorb}}. She offered to help them locate their missing friend {{an|Dawn}}, who had already gone into the forest after her runaway {{TP|Dawn|Mamoswine}}. During their search, the aforementioned Tangrowth attacked them and used Absorb on {{AP|Grotle}}, sapping its energy. Strangely, after it took Grotle's energy, it left behind a [[Sitrus Berry]] to help it recover.

Verona eventually discovered that the energy Tangrowth was taking from the Pokémon was being used to help a dying tree. Tangrowth never meant any harm to the Pokémon, which was why it would leave behind either an {{b|Oran}} or a [[Sitrus Berry]] so that they would get better. After the tree became healthier, Verona decided to work with Tangrowth in order to protect the forest.
